scientific_integrity: The infinite theorem is justified by the residual-identity, reachability and inequivalence proof. Finite programmatic checks corroborate but do not establish all quantified cases. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification is restricted to shifted binary digit-sum words with alphabet modulus at least two, LSD-first input and redundant trailing-zero padding. It does not address most-significant-digit-first complexity, arbitrary numeral bases or arbitrary automatic words; possible unindexed priority and independent validation remain outstanding.
title: Exact least-significant-first state complexity of shifted binary digit-sum words
